description_en: Retrieves the basic information and source file information of multiple media assets in a batch
description_zh: 批量获取媒资基础信息和源文件信息
name: BatchGetMediaInfos

parameters.help_en:
The media asset IDs, which are audio/video IDs (VideoId). Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). You can specify up to 20 IDs. You can obtain the IDs by using the following methods:

For audio/video files uploaded through the console, log on to the ApsaraVideo VOD console and choose Media Files > Audio/Video to view the audio/video IDs.
When you call the operation to obtain the upload URL and credential for audio/video files, the VideoId value is returned as a response parameter.
After an audio/video file is uploaded, you can call the SearchMedia operation to query the VideoId value in the response
parameters.help_zh:
媒资ID，即音/视频ID（VideoId）。多个ID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔，最多支持20个。可通过以下方式获取：

通过控制台上传的音/视频，可登录点播控制台，选择媒资库 > 音/视频查看音/视频ID。
通过获取音视频上传地址和凭证接口获取上传地址和凭证时，为返回参数VideoId的值。
音/视频上传后，可通过搜索媒体信息接口查询，为请求后返回参数VideoId的值
parameters.name: media_ids

parameters.help_en: The list of custom IDs. Separate multiple custom IDs with commas (,). You can specify up to 20 IDs
parameters.help_zh: 自定义 ID 列表。由一个或多个自定义 ID 组成，多个 ID 之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。最多支持 20 个
parameters.name: reference_ids

ForbiddenMediaIds.description_en: The list of media asset IDs that are forbidden. This is typically because you do not have permissions for multi-application operations. For more information, see [Multi-application]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113600.html）
ForbiddenMediaIds.description_zh: 被禁止操作的媒资ID列表，通常是由于没有多应用的权限而导致被禁止操作，更多信息，请参见[多应用]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113600.html）

items.description_en: The list of media asset IDs that are forbidden. This is typically because you do not have permissions for multi-application operations. For more information, see [Multi-application]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113600.html）
items.description_zh: 被禁止操作的媒资ID列表，通常是由于没有多应用的权限而导致被禁止操作，更多信息，请参见[多应用]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/113600.html）

MediaInfo.description_en: The basic information of the media asset

CoverURL.description_en: The thumbnail URL of the audio/video file

CreationTime.description_en: The time when the audio/video file was created. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
CreationTime.description_zh: 音/视频创建时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

Description.description_en: The description of the audio/video file

DownloadSwitch.description_en:
The status of the offline download switch. After the offline download feature is enabled, mobile users can cache videos to their local devices for viewing by using ApsaraVideo Player. For more information, see [Offline download]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86107.html）. Valid values:

on: Offline download is enabled.
off: Offline download is disabled
DownloadSwitch.description_zh:
离线下载开关状态，打开离线下载功能后，则允许移动端用户通过阿里云播放器将视频缓存至本地观看。具体操作，请参见[离线下载]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86107.html）。取值：

on：开启，允许离线下载。
off：关闭，禁止离线下载

ModificationTime.description_en: The last time when the audio/video file was updated. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)
ModificationTime.description_zh: 音/视频的最后一次更新时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）

ReferenceId.description_en: The custom ID. Only lowercase letters, uppercase letters, digits, hyphens, and underscores are supported. The ID must be 6 to 64 characters in length and is unique at the user level
ReferenceId.description_zh: 自定义ID，仅支持小写字母、大写字母、数字、横线、下划线，长度 6-64 位。用户维度唯一
ReferenceId.title_en: 自定义ID，仅支持小写字母、大写字母、数字、横线、下划线，长度 6-64 位。用户维度唯一。
ReferenceId.title_zh: 自定义ID，仅支持小写字母、大写字母、数字、横线、下划线，长度 6-64 位。用户维度唯一。

RestoreExpiration.description_en: The expiration time of the media asset restoration

RestoreStatus.description_en:
The restoration status of the media asset. Valid values:
Processing: The media asset is being restored.
Success: The media asset is restored.
Failed: The media asset failed to be restored
RestoreStatus.description_zh:
媒资解冻状态。取值：
Processing：解冻中。
Success：解冻成功。
Failed：解冻失败

items.description_en:
The video snapshot URL array.
This operation returns only the thumbnail snapshot data of the video. To query snapshot data of normal snapshots, sprites, sprite source images, or WebVTT snapshots captured by the [video snapshot]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/99368.html） feature, call the [ListSnapshots](~~ListSnapshots~~) operation
items.description_zh:
视频截图URL数组。
本接口仅会返回视频的封面截图数据，通过[视频截图]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/99368.html）功能截取的普通截图、雪碧截图、雪碧图原始图、WebVTT截图的截图数据，请调用[ListSnapshots](~~ListSnapshots~~)接口查询

Status.description_en:
The video status. Valid values:

Uploading: The video is being uploaded.
UploadFail: The video failed to be uploaded.
UploadSucc: The video has been uploaded.
Transcoding: The video is being transcoded.
TranscodeFail: The video failed to be transcoded.
Blocked: The video is blocked.
Normal: The video is in a normal state
Status.description_zh:
视频状态。取值：

Uploading：上传中。
UploadFail：上传失败。
UploadSucc：上传完成。
Transcoding：转码中。
TranscodeFail：转码失败。
Blocked：屏蔽。
Normal：正常

StorageClass.description_en:
The storage class of the media asset. Valid values:
Standard: standard.
IA: Infrequent Access for media assets.
Archive: Archive for media assets.
ColdArchive: Cold Archive for media assets.
SourceIA: Infrequent Access for source files.
SourceArchive: Archive for source files.
SourceColdArchive: Cold Archive for source files.
Changing: The storage class of the media asset is being changed.
SourceChanging: The storage class of the source file is being changed
StorageClass.description_zh:
媒资存储类型。取值：
Standard：标准。
IA：媒资低频。
Archive：媒资归档。
ColdArchive：媒资冷归档。
SourceIA：源文件低频。
SourceArchive：源文件归档。
SourceColdArchive：源文件冷归档。
Changing：媒资存储类型变更中。
SourceChanging：源文件存储类型变更中

Title.description_en: The title of the audio/video file

Definition.description_en:
The definition of the video stream. Valid values:

FD: low definition.
LD: standard definition.
SD: high definition.
HD: ultra high definition.
OD: original quality.
2K: 2K.
4K: 4K.
SQ: standard sound quality.
HQ: high sound quality.
AUTO: adaptive bitrate streaming
Definition.description_zh:
视频流清晰度定义。取值：

FD：流畅。
LD：标清。
SD：高清。
HD：超清
OD：原画。
2K：2K。
4K：4K。
SQ：普通音质。
HQ：高音质。
AUTO：自适应码率

Duration.description_en: The duration of the media stream. Unit: seconds

Encrypt.description_en:
Indicates whether the media stream is encrypted. Valid values:

0: The stream is not encrypted.
1: The stream is encrypted
Encrypt.description_zh:
媒体流是否加密流，取值：

0：否。
1：是

EncryptMode.description_en:
The encryption mode of the media stream. Valid values:

License: local decryption mode.

If the encryption mode is License, only ApsaraVideo Player SDK can be used for playback
EncryptMode.description_zh:
媒体流加密模式。取值：

License：本地解密模式。

如果加密模式为License，则只能使用阿里云播放器SDK才能正常播放

EncryptType.description_en:
The encryption type of the media stream. Valid values:

AliyunVoDEncryption: Alibaba Cloud video encryption.
HLSEncryption: HLS encryption.

If the encryption type is AliyunVoDEncryption, only ApsaraVideo Player SDK can be used for playback
EncryptType.description_zh:
媒体流加密类型。取值：

AliyunVoDEncryption：阿里云视频加密。
HLSEncryption：HLS标准加密。

如果加密类型为AliyunVoDEncryption，则只能使用阿里云播放器SDK才能正常播放

Format.description_en:
The format of the media stream.
If the media file is a video, valid values are mp4 and m3u8.
If the media file is audio-only, the value is mp3
Format.description_zh:
媒体流格式。
若媒体文件为视频则取值： mp4、 m3u8。
若是纯音频则取值：mp3

Fps.description_en: The frame rate of the media stream. Unit: frames per second
Fps.description_zh: 媒体流帧率。单位：帧/每秒

HDR
HDR10
HLG
DolbyVision
HDRVivid
SDR+
HDRType.description_zh:
媒体流HDR类型。取值：
HDR
HDR10
HLG
DolbyVision
HDRVivid
SDR+

Height.description_en: The height of the media stream. Unit: px

JobExt.description_en: The custom watermark information of the copyright watermark. This field is returned only when `JobType` is `2`
JobExt.description_zh: 版权水印的自定义水印信息。仅当`JobType`为`2`时返回该字段

JobId.description_en: The job ID of the media stream transcoding. This value serves as the unique identifier of the media stream
JobId.description_zh: 媒体流转码的作业ID。作为媒体流的唯一标识

JobType.description_en:
The digital watermarking type. Valid values:
1: tracing watermark.
2: copyright watermark
JobType.description_zh:
数字水印类型。取值：
1：溯源水印。
2：版权水印

ModificationTime.description_en: The time when the stream was last updated. The time is in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format (UTC)

NarrowBandType.description_en:
The transcoding type. Valid values:

0: standard transcoding.
1.0: Narrowband HD 1.0 transcoding.
2.0: Narrowband HD 2.0 transcoding
NarrowBandType.description_zh:
转码类型。取值：

0：普通转码。
1.0：窄带高清1.0转码。
2.0：窄带高清2.0转码

PlayURL.description_en: The playback URL of the video stream

Size.description_en: The size of the media stream. Unit: bytes

Specification.description_en: The output specification of the audio/video transcoding. For more information about valid values and descriptions, see [Output specifications: Specification](~~124671#section-6bv-l0g-opq~~)
Specification.description_zh: 音视频转码输出规格。各取值及描述，请参见[输出规格：Specification](~~124671#section-6bv-l0g-opq~~)

Status.description_en:
The status of the media stream. Valid values:

Normal: The stream is in a normal state. This value indicates the status of the latest transcoded stream for each definition and format.
Invisible: The stream is invisible. When multiple duplicate transcoded streams exist for each definition and format, only the latest stream is marked as Normal, and the other streams are marked as Invisible
Status.description_zh:
媒体流状态，取值：

Normal：正常状态，标记的是每种清晰度和格式的一路最新转码完成的流的状态。
Invisible：不可见状态，当每种清晰度和格式有多路重复的转码流时，除了最新的一路流会被标记为正常状态，其他流会被标记为不可见状态

StreamType.description_en:
The type of the media stream.
If the media stream is a video, the value is video. If the media stream is audio-only, the value is audio
StreamType.description_zh:
媒体流类型。
若媒体流为视频则取值：video，若是纯音频则取值：audio

WatermarkId.description_en: The watermark template ID associated with the current media stream
WatermarkId.description_zh: 当前媒体流关联的水印模板ID

Width.description_en: The width of the media stream. Unit: px
